{"basis":"measured","fact_type":"defect","name":"DEFECT (measured 2026-09-30): the lens reflow2 serves still tells the agent to ask the reader's background and "record it with add_contributor" — writing a reader's persona INTO the design, which this accepted requirement says reflow2's served text must not do","statement":"OBSERVED:
- crates/reflow2-mcp/src/skills.rs:382 on origin/main, the lens text served on list_skills, get_skill and loop_status, reads: "Ask what they do day to day and what they trained in (those often differ and both matter), then record it with `add_contributor`."
- The same text came back live today on a design hosted on flo2.io (graph-primitives), where the only person recorded was the signed-in account's contributor, with no background.

EXPECTED, per this requirement (accepted): "It does NOT store a reader's persona … With neither [a host-supplied persona nor the agent's own memory], the agent follows the person's own vocabulary and may ask once, without writing the answer into the design. reflow2's served text says this, rather than telling the agent to record a background in the design."

WHY IT MATTERS NOW: flo2 is building the account persona (flo2 req:flo2-holds-each-persons-persona-and-hands-it-to-the-agent-with-the-design, scheduled in flo2 epoch:a-reader-gets-a-document-written-for-them). Until this text changes, every new hosted design's agent is told to write the reader's background into the design, the option flo2's dec:idea-a-persona-lens-per-person rejected.

Found while answering @ajs's "I'm still not sure that we are getting its implementation correct". Not yet root-caused: why an accepted requirement's "served text says this" clause shipped without the text changing, and whether any check reads it.

ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured), 2026-09-30, the same day. Run as the skill on @ajs's "need to fix: reflow2 still tells agents to write the reader's background into the design".

⑤ MEASURED:
- C1 HOLDS. The sentence entered skills.rs in 945f18f on 2026-08-26 (#353, "The lens rides the skill response"), a month BEFORE this requirement was accepted (2026-09-28). This requirement has NO satisfying capability and NO verification. Its only edges are AUTHORED_BY who:ajs and EVOLVES_INTO from dec:idea-a-user-carries-a-persona-that-shapes-every-reply. So nothing was built or scheduled against its "reflow2's served text says this" clause.
- C2 (several copies, one updated) is refuted: skills.rs:382 is the only served copy.
- C3 (tests pin the wording) is refuted: the lens tests call add_contributor to set up data, and none asserts the sentence.

- a failing-first check that no served text tells an agent to write a reader's background into the design;
